title: Semi-Annual Airport Lighting Vault Inspection

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: Ground resistance: _______ Ω (SAT if ≤ 25 Ω; preferred ≤ 10 Ω)
All primary high-voltage buses — no overheating, corrosion, or loose connections
All ground buses — no corrosion or defective connections
All relays inspected — settings correct per as-built documentation
Oil fuse cutouts — oil level and condition satisfactory
ATS tested — transfer time: _______ sec (SAT if ≤ 15 sec)
ATS dropout voltage: _______ V | Pickup voltage: _______ V
All control panel indicators, alarms, and controls functional
Lightning arresters — no physical damage; properly installed
All DANGER signs present, legible, and secure
Vault security — all locks and door hardware functional
Safety board fully stocked; all PPE within certification dates
Current as-built electrical schematic posted and verified correct

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C14-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
